name: Robotic Pool Skimmer
definition: A self-propelled pool-surface cleaning robot designed to collect floating debris before it sinks, using onboard propulsion, debris capture, power and control systems.
includedScope: Solar-assisted and rechargeable robotic pool-surface skimmers
Models with onboard debris baskets and autonomous propulsion
excludedScope: Submerged robotic pool cleaners and suction-side cleaners
Fixed pool skimmers, manual nets and water-quality treatment systems
primaryApplications: Outdoor residential pool surface debris collection
Leaves, insects, pollen and other manufacturer-declared floating debris
headline: Robotic pool skimmer propulsion, baskets, charging and buyer checks
description: This profile separates solar and plug-in charging, propulsion, inlet and basket design, obstacle sensing, edge behavior, runtime, app control, pool geometry and chemistry so buyers can compare surface robots without confusing them with submerged pool cleaners.
metaDescription: Robotic pool skimmer guide covering solar charging, propulsion, baskets, models, pool fit, safety and buyer checks.
disclaimer: This independent category reference is not pool-safety, electrical, water-chemistry or disinfection advice. Confirm the exact regional model, manual, pool shape, waterline obstacles, chemistry, charging method, basket, app, retrieval, storage and bather-exclusion procedure before procurement or use.

keyFacts.label: Category boundary
keyFacts.value: Self-propelled floating robot with onboard debris capture
keyFacts.evidence: Official pages describe powered surface movement and removable baskets or filter trays.
keyFacts.scope: Named surface skimmers; submerged robots and fixed skimmers excluded.

keyFacts.label: Buyer verification
keyFacts.value: Match sunlight, pool geometry, obstacles, debris, chemistry and retrieval to exact model
keyFacts.evidence: Manufacturers publish materially different charging, sensing, capacity, runtime and pool limits.
keyFacts.scope: Exact regional model, firmware and pool.

systemFlow.name: Power, control and propulsion
systemFlow.componentFamily: Solar panel, battery, optional charger, controller, motors, paddles or propellers and connectivity
systemFlow.role: Powers autonomous movement and model-specific control modes at the water surface.
systemFlow.evidence: Official sources publish solar-assisted charging, batteries, propulsion and app controls.
systemFlow.scope: Exact charger, battery, firmware and market.

systemFlow.name: Debris guidance and capture
systemFlow.componentFamily: Inlet, front roller or baffle, edge brushes, basket or filter tray and non-return flap
systemFlow.role: Guides floating debris into onboard storage while limiting escape.
systemFlow.evidence: Manufacturers publish materially different inlet and basket systems.
systemFlow.scope: Declared floating debris and exact filter.

variants.name: Solar-autonomous skimmer
variants.taskScale: Continuous or scheduled outdoor surface-debris interception
variants.operatorRelationship: User deploys, periodically retrieves and rinses the basket and solar panel
variants.spaceConstraints: Sun exposure, shade pattern, waterline obstacles, ledges and storage
variants.limitations: Solar panel rating or 24/7 wording does not guarantee uninterrupted operation.
variants.evidence: Beatbot, Aiper, WYBOT and Maytronics publish solar-assisted formats.

variants.name: Dual-charge connected skimmer
variants.taskScale: Surface cleaning with solar support and model-specific plug-in charging or app control
variants.operatorRelationship: User manages charge state, schedules, remote steering, updates and retrieval
variants.spaceConstraints: Dry charging location, wireless coverage, app account and storage
variants.limitations: Connectivity does not establish autonomous coverage or future cloud support.
variants.evidence: Aiper and Beatbot publish adapter or wireless charging and app features.

performanceMetrics.name: Runtime and charging
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: Available operating time across sunlight, shade and night conditions
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Solar input, adapter or wireless charging, battery mode and environmental conditions differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Maximum runtime, panel watts or battery capacity alone do not prove 24-hour availability.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Official pages publish distinct charging architectures and qualified runtimes.

performanceMetrics.name: Debris capture and coverage
performanceMetrics.purchasingMeaning: How the robot intercepts declared floating debris across an actual pool
performanceMetrics.reportingBoundary: Basket volume, filter opening, propulsion, path planning, edge behavior, wind and debris load differ
performanceMetrics.comparisonCaution: Basket liters, microns or sensor count alone do not establish complete cleaning.
performanceMetrics.evidence: Manufacturers publish different basket, filter and navigation claims.

applicationFit.application: Outdoor pool with recurring leaves, insects or pollen
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Observe several complete operating windows across wind, shade and changing debris load.
applicationFit.basis: Surface flow, wind, pool shape, obstacles, charging and basket condition interact.
applicationFit.limitations: No catalogue statement guarantees every floating particle is captured.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Map missed zones and record charge, runtime, debris, stalls and basket service frequency.
applicationFit.evidence: Official pages define debris types, charging and pool boundaries.

applicationFit.application: Pool with ledges, covers, hoses or another robot
applicationFit.wcbAssessment: Conduct an obstruction and entanglement trial before unattended scheduling.
applicationFit.basis: Waterline geometry and floating or submerged objects can trap or redirect a surface robot.
applicationFit.limitations: Obstacle sensors do not eliminate all stranding or entanglement.
applicationFit.buyerAction: Document obstacles, cover position, hose or cable coexistence and retrieval procedure.
applicationFit.evidence: Manufacturers publish obstacle sensors, anti-stranding features and coexistence guidance.

componentStack.name: Power, propulsion and sensing
componentStack.role: Supplies energy, moves the robot and responds to pool boundaries or obstacles.
variants: Solar plus adapter or wireless charging
componentStack.evidence: Official sources document distinct power and navigation systems.
componentStack.scope: No cross-model battery, charger or sensor compatibility.

componentStack.name: Inlet, basket and retrieval system
componentStack.role: Captures floating debris and enables servicing and removal from the pool.
componentStack.evidence: Manufacturers publish different capacities, filters and replacement parts.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Actual coverage, basket loading, obstacle behavior, charging and retrieval
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Ranking by panel watts, runtime, basket liters or sensor count alone
procurementDecisions.assessment: Run repeated observed operating windows in the intended pool.
procurementDecisions.basis: Pool flow, wind, shade, debris, navigation and maintenance interact.
procurementDecisions.limitations: No catalogue metric guarantees complete surface coverage.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Record missed zones, stalls, charge state, debris and service frequency.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Official sources show materially different operating boundaries.

procurementDecisions.attributeToVerify: Battery, charger, basket, filter, app, firmware and replacement parts
procurementDecisions.comparisonTrap: Assuming family labels or visual fit establish compatibility
procurementDecisions.assessment: Attach exact part codes and offline operating behavior to the quote.
procurementDecisions.basis: Critical assemblies and software are model-specific.
procurementDecisions.limitations: Future cloud, app or part availability is not guaranteed.
procurementDecisions.buyerAction: Obtain codes, prices, warranty, update policy and manual retrieval procedure.
procurementDecisions.evidence: Product, manual and parts pages identify exact systems.

engineeringChecks.reason: Wet equipment, lithium batteries and chargers require exact separation and environmental limits.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Follow the exact manual for charging, dry connectors, temperature, deployment and storage.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Official product pages and manuals publish charging and environmental boundaries.

engineeringChecks.check: Pool obstacles, chemistry and bather exclusion
engineeringChecks.reason: Hoses, covers, ledges, high chemicals and swimmers affect safe operation and materials.
engineeringChecks.buyerAction: Confirm chemistry limits, remove bathers as instructed and test every obstruction before unattended use.
engineeringChecks.evidence: Manufacturer manuals and support guidance define exact operating precautions.

standards.name: Manufacturer model manual and regional conformity requirements
standards.applicability: Primary charging, water-exposure, bather-exclusion, pool-compatibility, app and maintenance boundary for the exact surface robot.
standards.evidence: Maytronics and Aiper publish model manuals or official support documentation.
standards.scope: Exact model and market; no universal pool-skimmer performance standard is claimed.

developments.title: Maytronics disclosed Skimmi 200 and Skimmi 300 for the 2026 launch season
developments.summary: Maytronics' Q3 2025 report identifies Skimmi 200 and Skimmi 300 as next-generation floating skimmers scheduled for launch in 2026.
developments.evidence: The official Q3 report names both models, describes their surface-cleaning category and states the planned 2026 launch timing.
developments.scope: Company plan disclosed on the report approval date; later regional availability and specifications require exact-market checks.
